items.source:
The name of the index. If null or empty, then the index name will be generated by Cassandra and will be
unknown unless column metadata is used to discover the generated index name.
items.translation: 索引名称。如果为 null 或空，则 Cassandra 将生成索引名称，除非使用列元数据来发现生成的索引名称，否则该名称将未知。

items.source: SASI indexing can apply an analyzer that is applied during indexing. Annotation-based indexing supports standard analyzer and non-tokenizing analyzer.
items.translation: SASI 索引可以应用一个在索引期间使用的分析器。基于注解的索引支持标准分析器和非分词分析器。

items.source:
SASI uses significantly using fewer memory, disk, and CPU resources. It enables querying with PREFIX and
CONTAINS on strings, similar to the SQL implementation of LIKE = "foo*" or
LIKE = "*foo*".
items.translation: SASI 显著减少了内存、磁盘和 CPU 资源的消耗。它支持在字符串上使用 PREFIX 和 CONTAINS 进行查询，类似于 SQL 中 LIKE = "foo*"或 LIKE = "*foo*"的实现方式。

items.source: Apply non-tokenizing analyzer to SASI indexing.
items.translation: 将非分词分析器应用于 SASI 索引。

items.source: Apply standard analyzer to SASI indexing.
items.translation: 对 SASI 索引应用标准分析器。

items.source: Identifies a secondary index using SASI indexing on a single column.
items.translation: 使用单列上的 SASI 索引识别二级索引。

items.source:
@Table
class Person {

        @SASI(analyzed = true, indexMode = CONTAINS) @StandardAnalyzed("en") String names; // allows LIKE queries
        @SASI int age // allows age >= … queries;
}
items.translation:
@Table
class Person {

    @SASI(analyzed = true, indexMode = CONTAINS) @StandardAnalyzed("en") String names; // 支持 LIKE 查询
    @SASI int age; // 支持 age >= … 查询；
}
